_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

open_questions: Network: UNRESOLVED after a second sweep on 2026-11-07 (wave 3, W7). The Laksya lounge T&C defines an eligible card as one "issued by AU Bank on Visa/RuPay Network", which covers every AU card and does not pick one; a "Visa Cardholders" popup on the page is the only Laksya-specific hint and is a block shared with other AU cards. Checked and found silent: the Laksya card art (listing tile and product-page art, no network mark on the front), the Laksya welcome T&C and the Amazon FreshNow, Zomato and District partner T&Cs, AU's 6 May 2026 portfolio press release and the Q1 FY27 results note, KFS v1.9 and MITC v2.23 (they name a network only for the CheQ Visa), and the Cardmember Agreement of 16 May 2026 (clauses 3.14 to 3.16 allow a network change at renewal and use "VISA/RuPay" for every card). visa.co.in, mastercard.co.in, npci.org.in and rupay.co.in carry no AU card list. Needs a physical card, the AU 0101 app card view, or a written answer from AU (1800 1200 1500; creditcard.support@aubank.in). card_product.network left null.

Reward Point value in rupees: not stated for Laksya. AU Rewardz FAQ and Cardmember Agreement clause 22.11 (16 May 2026 copy; 23.11 in the undated copy) say the conversion rate differs by card variant and point to the variant page, and the Laksya page, FAQ and welcome T&C state none. effective_base_return_percent left null.

notes: Xpress EMI processing fee is zero on Laksya per KFS section 12.

Reward Points are earned in multiples of ₹100 (CMA 23.22), modelled as floor; points expire after 2 years (CMA 23.8).
